meta.name: grill-me
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用访谈式提问帮您打磨计划与设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常常需要把不成熟的想法梳理得清晰可行
copy.tagline_en: Hone your plan or design through relentless questioning.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to sharpen rough ideas into clear plans.

howto.what: 它会让 Claude 对你展开一场不停追问的访谈，用来把计划或设计打磨得更清楚。具体做法是运行一个 /grilling 会话。
howto.when: 该技能设了 disable-model-invocation，Claude 不会自动调用；需要你手动发起 /grill-me，才会开始这场追问访谈。

say.text: 用 grill-me 访谈我，把这个方案追问一遍。
say.note: 会启动一场持续追问的访谈。

say.text: 开始 /grilling 会话，帮我打磨这份设计。
say.note: 进入追问式的打磨过程。

say.text: 一直追问下去，直到我的计划站得住脚。
say.note: Claude 会继续追问，不轻易放过。

howto.what_en: It makes Claude run a /grilling session: a relentless interview that sharpens your plan or design. Model invocation is disabled, so you start it yourself.
howto.when_en: Model invocation is disabled, so Claude will not start it on its own; you must invoke /grill-me yourself to begin the grilling session.

say_en.text: Use grill-me to interview me and push on this plan.
Start a /grilling session to sharpen this design.
Keep pushing until my plan holds up.
